calendar_title: Kannada Festivals and Special Days Calendar
location_basis: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Asia/Kolkata); tithi-based dates calculated with Swiss Ephemeris and Lahiri ayanamsha.
source_basis: Drik Panchang Karnataka/Bengaluru calendars for regional conventions and cross-checking.
Swiss Ephemeris calculations for the extended 100-year astronomical range.
notes: This extension uses a consistent astronomical calculation for the 100-year range rather than copying dates from North Indian calendars.
Tithi festivals use Bengaluru sunrise/sunset/night rules appropriate to the festival. Lunar month identification uses Amanta reckoning common in Karnataka and detects Adhika months.

Karnataka government holiday status can change by annual notification; the public-holiday flags here represent recurring/common status and should be checked against the specific annual state notification before administrative use.
Karaga, Kambala, Madikeri Dasara and Hampi Utsava are locally scheduled. Their entries are intentionally flagged as subject to local announcement and do not claim a fixed Gregorian date.
Mysuru Dasara has venue-specific scheduling and may differ from the generic Vijayadashami date; consult the annual Mysuru district/government announcement for procession and illumination dates.
